steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Baroque music features basso continuo (keyboard + cello/bass providing harmonic foundation) and terraced dynamics (sudden dynamic shifts, not gradual). | Key Fact: Handel's Coronation Anthems exemplify Baroque grandeur: choral polyphony, orchestral doubling, majestic key choices and ceremonial character. | Key Fact: Ground bass (repeated bass pattern) provides structural foundation — used in arias and instrumental works by Purcell and Handel. | Key Fact: Ornamentation (trills, mordents, grace notes) was often improvised by performers — Baroque notation is simpler than what was actually played.
